parent_objective: design cross-fault wrong-history scenario pairing after M704 reset-only result

public_gates: design prioritizes wrong-history evidence over reset-only evidence
design keeps hidden fault labels out of actor input
design blocks actor update PPO and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add fault labels to actor observations
do not treat reset-only rows as source-positive
do not relax wrong-history gates after seeing results
do not change actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_cross_fault_history: create wrong-history-critical rows by pairing incompatible hidden fault histories
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the cross-fault wrong-history pairing step after M704 produced reset-only sparse evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: scenario-pairing design only, not implementation, training, PPO, or driver performance
stop_condition: stop if design cannot make wrong-history evidence first-class
stop if reset-only rows would be promoted as source-positive
stop if proposed pairs cannot be matched on visible state
fallback_plan: if cross-fault matching is empty, relax state matching only through an audit
if wrong-history remains too mild, increase severity contrast
if normal-failed dominates, add warm-up or reduce severity
if current-model pairs remain insufficient, design a minimal four-wheel extension
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after cross-fault implementation and audit determine whether wrong-history rows exist

hypothesis: Cross-fault wrong-history pairing will produce stronger self-ID evidence than nominal-vs-fault pairing because the wrong hidden state will encode an incompatible capability belief.
success_criteria: objective actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats reset-only rows as source-positive
design admits actor update or PPO before source-positive evidence
decision_rule: M706 is design-only and passes if it defines a no-training cross-fault wrong-history pairing implementation while preserving the actor input contract and blocking actor update PPO and promotion.
